unit_system: each value carries its unit as the source states it; no conversion is applied inside the ledger
detector-atlas:value: the value as written in the source (a string), with its unit; ranges, approximate values and several values separated by '; ' keep the source's wording
detector-atlas:kind: design (a goal, requirement or as-designed parameter), achieved (measured, for example in a beam test or calibration) or operating (a value during data taking); the three are separate claims
detector-atlas:valid_for: the configuration or period the value describes (for example before and after an upgrade); a value is never carried to another configuration
